up: Retrieve IC50 activity values in nM for compounds tested against the human target 'Phosphatidylinositol 4,5-bisphosphate 3-kinase catalytic subunit alpha'. Return the following columns: compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, pubmed_id_or_doi (preferring pubmed_id, fallback to doi), assay_description, and target_pref_name. Include rows only where the compound has a valid canonical_smiles and a valid pubmed_id_or_doi. The activity must be exact IC50 values (standard_relation = '=') in nM. Filter for human organism (tax_id = 9606).
sql:
SELECT
  md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  COALESCE(d.pubmed_id, d.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi,
  ass.description AS assay_description,
  td.pref_name AS target_pref_name
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id
WHERE
  td.pref_name = 'Phosphatidylinositol 4,5-bisphosphate 3-kinase catalytic subunit alpha'
  AND td.tax_id = 9606
  AND a.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND a.standard_relation = '='
  AND a.standard_units = 'nM'
  AND cs.canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL
  AND COALESCE(d.pubmed_id, d.doi) IS NOT NULL
